title: Browser checks and Lighthouse for create-then-stats
what: Extend e2e/browser-checks.js (Playwright) with the create-then-stats journey: create a Link on the page, read the Manage Token from the result panel, follow 'See its stats' (Short Code pre-filled, no token), enter the token and see the Stats. Assert the token never appears in the page URL at any step, and that a wrong token shows the 404 message. Add /stats to the Lighthouse run (median of 3, score >= 90), and fix any accessibility or performance issue it finds.
acceptance: Playwright check completes create, copy token, open stats link, submit token, see Stats
The page URL never contains the token at any step
A wrong token shows 'No stats found for that Short Code and manage token.'
CI job 'Browser checks (Playwright + Lighthouse)' passes with its name unchanged

title: Privacy and log-safety tests for Stats and the Manage Token
what: Add integration tests (OutputCaptureExtension) proving the Manage Token and Authorization header never appear in log output across create, Stats success and the 404, and that the Stats body holds none of the raw Referer or User-Agent values sent. Also assert the identical-404 contract (unknown Short Code, pre-R2 Link without a hash, missing or non-Bearer or empty header, wrong token, another Link's token) is byte-for-byte equal, Cache-Control no-store on token-bearing and Stats responses, and that Link.toString omits the token. Only add production changes if a test finds a real leak. Do not re-implement shipped features.
acceptance: A log-capture test covers create, Stats 200 and Stats 404 and finds no token, hash or Authorization value
A test sends distinct Referer and User-Agent values and asserts the Stats body contains neither
All 404 cases are compared against the first case: status line, headers and body are equal
POST /links, POST / and every Stats response carry Cache-Control: no-store
Link.toString does not include the Manage Token
GET /stats?manage_token=... never uses the token from the query string
Plan 0001 matrix rows and the spec 0005 coverage entries for stories 7, 19-24 are added

title: Document Stats: architecture, glossary, onboarding, README, roadmap, plan
what: Bring the documents up to date with the shipped Stats feature: the Stats flow and token-bearing create flow in docs/architecture.md; Manage Token, Stats and Headline Click count in CONTEXT.md; how to try Stats locally in docs/onboarding.md; README and the spec index and R2 row of docs/roadmap.md; and phase P9 in docs/plans/0001-integration-testing.md with a complete spec 0005 coverage table mapping each user story to its test, including the privacy and browser tickets. Check the spec status is consistent (implemented). Do not touch the release close-out items.
acceptance: docs/architecture.md shows the create-with-token and Stats flows in Mermaid
CONTEXT.md defines Manage Token, Stats and Headline Click count using the spec's wording
docs/onboarding.md explains creating a Link and reading its Stats locally using PORT=8765 and a scratch DATA_DIR
README, docs/specs/README.md and the R2 row of docs/roadmap.md reflect Stats
Plan 0001 has P9 and every user story 1-29 maps to a test or document
No dead links in the edited files
